level.label: Level
level.hover: The overall loudness of the sound. Range 0.1 to 3.

thresh.label: Strike threshold
thresh.hover: How fast the key must be pressed for a strike to count as a hit. Range 0.005 to 0.2.

span.label: Strike range
span.hover: How much faster than the threshold a strike must be to count as a full-strength hit: lower is more sensitive. Range 0.2 to 1.5.

hard.label: Mallet hardness
hard.hover: How hard the mallet is at the softest strike. Range 0.2 to 1.2.

hardvel.label: Hardness by strike
hardvel.hover: How much harder the mallet gets with a stronger strike. Range 0 to 1.

tilt.label: Hardness by timbre
tilt.hover: How much timbre changes the mallet's hardness at the strike. Range 0 to 0.5.

mute.label: Strike mute
mute.hover: How much of the ringing a full strike stops, like a hand on the bar. Range 0 to 1.

upper.label: Upper partials
upper.hover: The level of all partials but the first, relative to the instrument's own. Range 0 to 2.

decay.label: Decay
decay.hover: How long the bar rings, as a scale on the instrument's own. Range 0.1 to 4.

keytrack.label: Decay by register
keytrack.hover: How much shorter the high notes ring than the low ones. Range 0 to 1.5.

hfdamp.label: Upper damping
hfdamp.hover: How much faster the upper partials die than the fundamental. Range 0 to 1.

damper.label: Damper
damper.hover: How firmly the damper stops the note on release: 0 no dampers. Range 0 to 2.

lift.label: Damper lift
lift.hover: The key pressure above which the damper is fully lifted. Range 0.02 to 0.5.

pedal.label: Damper by pedal
pedal.hover: How far the pedal lifts the damper: 1 fully. Range 0 to 1.

trem.label: Motor tremolo
trem.hover: The vibraphone's motor tremolo: on or off. Range off or on.

tremrate.label: Tremolo speed
tremrate.hover: How fast the motor turns. Range 1 to 10 Hz.

tremdepth.label: Tremolo depth
tremdepth.hover: How deep the tremolo pulses the loudness. Range 0 to 1.

tremthr.label: Tremolo by pressure
tremthr.hover: The key pressure above which pressing harder adds tremolo. Range 0.2 to 1.2.

rub.label: Rub
rub.hover: The level of the rubbed tone per unit of pressure, like a finger on a glass: 0 off. Range 0 to 1.

rubnoise.label: Rub noise
rubnoise.hover: How much of the rubbed tone is noise. Range 0 to 0.3.

model.label: Instrument
model.hover: Which instrument: vibraphone, marimba, glockenspiel, church bell, kalimba or wine glass. Range steps 0 to 5.
